1.web: Praise Yah! Praise Yahweh’s name! Praise him, you servants of Yahweh,
1.asv: Praise ye Jehovah. Praise ye the name of Jehovah; Praisehim, O ye servants of Jehovah,

2.web: you who stand in Yahweh’s house, in the courts of our God’s house.
2.asv: Ye that stand in the house of Jehovah, In the courts of the house of our God.

3.web: Praise Yah, for Yahweh is good. Sing praises to his name, for that is pleasant.
3.asv: Praise ye Jehovah; for Jehovah is good: Sing praises unto his name; for it is pleasant.

4.web: For Yah has chosen Jacob for himself; Israel for his own possession.
4.asv: For Jehovah hath chosen Jacob unto himself, AndIsrael for his own possession.

5.web: For I know that Yahweh is great, that our Lord is above all gods.
5.asv: For I know that Jehovah is great, And that our Lord is above all gods.

6.web: Whatever Yahweh pleased, that he has done, in heaven and in earth, in the seas and in all deeps;
6.asv: Whatsoever Jehovah pleased, that hath he done, In heaven and in earth, in the seas and in all deeps;

7.web: who causes the clouds to rise from the ends of the earth; who makes lightnings with the rain; who brings the wind out of his treasuries;
7.asv: Who causeth the vapors to ascend from the ends of the earth; Who maketh lightnings for the rain; Who bringeth forth the wind out of his treasuries;

8.web: Who struck the firstborn of Egypt, both of man and animal;
8.asv: Who smote the first-born of Egypt, Both of man and beast;

9.web: Who sent signs and wonders into your midst, Egypt, on Pharaoh, and on all his servants;
9.asv: Who sent signs and wonders into the midst of thee, O Egypt, Upon Pharaoh, and upon all his servants;

10.web: who struck many nations, and killed mighty kings,
10.asv: Who smote many nations, And slew mighty kings,

11.web: Sihon king of the Amorites, Og king of Bashan, and all the kingdoms of Canaan,
11.asv: Sihon king of the Amorites, And Og king of Bashan, And all the kingdoms of Canaan,

12.web: and gave their land for a heritage, a heritage to Israel, his people.
12.asv: And gave their land for a heritage, A heritage unto Israel his people.

13.web: Your name, Yahweh, endures forever; your renown, Yahweh, throughout all generations.
13.asv: Thy name, O Jehovah, endurethfor ever; Thy memorial name, O Jehovah, throughout all generations.

14.web: For Yahweh will judge his people, and have compassion on his servants.
14.asv: For Jehovah will judge his people, And repent himself concerning his servants.

15.web: The idols of the nations are silver and gold, the work of men’s hands.
15.asv: The idols of the nations are silver and gold, The work of men’s hands.

16.web: They have mouths, but they can’t speak. They have eyes, but they can’t see.
16.asv: They have mouths, but they speak not; Eyes have they, but they see not;

17.web: They have ears, but they can’t hear; neither is there any breath in their mouths.
17.asv: They have ears, but they hear not; Neither is there any breath in their mouths.

18.web: Those who make them will be like them; yes, everyone who trusts in them.
18.asv: They that make them shall be like unto them; Yea, every one that trusteth in them.

19.web: House of Israel, praise Yahweh! House of Aaron, praise Yahweh!
19.asv: O house of Israel, bless ye Jehovah: O house of Aaron, bless ye Jehovah:

20.web: House of Levi, praise Yahweh! You who fear Yahweh, praise Yahweh!
20.asv: O house of Levi, bless ye Jehovah: Ye that fear Jehovah, bless ye Jehovah.

21.web: Blessed be Yahweh from Zion, Who dwells at Jerusalem. Praise Yah!
21.asv: Blessed be Jehovah out of Zion, Who dwelleth at Jerusalem. Praise ye Jehovah.
